description: Search VibeBooking's registry of independent hotels and inns in Japan by destination area: a city, ward, district or station name as it appears in a hotel's address (日本語 or English, e.g. 京都市東山区, Gion, 河原町). This is where the traveller wants to stay, not where they are. The registry is small and growing: when it has no match, use your own web search to find hotels' websites, then call resolve_hotel with each domain. Each hit carries the hotel id to pass to get_hotel (its facts and room types) or get_rates. With checkin, nights and guests (and children), each hit also carries its cheapest offer for that stay, as get_rates gives it, with its booking_url. other_hotels lists hotels elsewhere in the same prefecture that are not VibeBooking's, from our agent-readiness index: each one's own site and how far an agent can get there (level 0 invisible, 1 discoverable, 2 priceable, 3 machine-readable, 4 transactable), at min_level or above. There are no rates or booking links for them here: give the traveller the hotel's own site, saying we have not checked it.

area.description: Where the traveller wants to stay: a city, ward, district or station name.

children.description: Number of children (under 18) in the party; leave out for none.

min_level.description: Lowest agent-readiness level to list in other_hotels, 0 to 4; default 1.

name: search_hotels
title: Search hotels
